description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of  Exchange effective from 27.01.2020 to 02.02.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification pertains to legal/regulatory matters concerning customs operations. It exercises powers under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) to determine and publish official rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. The content involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements for customs operations, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification category.
